find_program(GLSLC glslc REQUIRED)
file(GLOB SHADERS *.vert *.frag)
foreach(S ${SHADERS})
  add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${S}.spv COMMAND ${GLSLC} ${S} -o ${S}.spv DEPENDS ${S})
endforeach()
